title: Review of HDB Flat Size Eligibility Criterion for Silver Support Scheme
what_it_is: Review of HDB Flat Size Eligibility Criterion for Silver Support Scheme

sections.label: Silver Support property ownership eligibility
sections.summary: Property ownership, including 5-room or larger HDB flats, affects Silver Support eligibility, with appeals possible and Budget 2024 enhancements raising the income threshold.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Property ownership is indicative of the senior’s resources and remains relevant in ensuring the Silver Support Scheme is targeted at seniors who need it the most.

In particular, seniors who own a 5-room or larger Housing and Development Board (HDB) flat are likely to have more resources and access to additional retirement funds, and hence, are not eligible for Silver Support.

Nonetheless, seniors who face unique circumstances, including those who own 5-room or larger HDB flats with short remaining leases and low annual values, can write in to the Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board to review their eligibility for Silver Support.
To strengthen support for retirement adequacy, the Government announced enhancements to the Silver Support Scheme at Budget 2024.
This includes increasing the qualifying per capita household income threshold to support more seniors.

sections.label: Silver Support targeting and appeals
sections.summary: The Silver Support Scheme targets the bottom 20% to 30% of seniors, using per capita household income and housing type as indicators, with appeals considered case-by-case.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Silver Support Scheme is one of those more targeted schemes that is meant to support the bottom 20% to 30% of seniors who have little or no family support currently and earned lower wages during their working years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, per capita household income is thus quite relevant to assess their overall support structure and the housing type that they live in or own is but one of those other indicators as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But certainly, we will consider the Member's suggestion to look at each appeal on a case-by-case basis.
